request.message: Compare the last five completed training runs across the assignment experiments and select a comparable candidate by f1_macro maximizing. Include recorded metrics and comparison limitations.

evidence.selection_scope: Only the returned recent window, not all historical runs
caveats: Scores are comparable only within one evaluation_id (data, split and metric policy).
Repeated selection on this small held-out split introduces selection bias; no independent final test.
Best requested metric is a candidate, not production readiness or a retraining recommendation.
No deployment, freshness, drift, latency or quality-gate evidence is supplied by this tool.
